newsitem.title: GERMANY: Hypo-Bank buys Brau und Brunnen with view to sell.
newsitem.headline: Hypo-Bank buys Brau und Brunnen with view to sell.

text.p: Bavarian bank Hypo-Bank said on Thursday that it had bought a controlling stake in the brewing and drinks group Brau und Brunnen AG with a view to selling its stake on.

Hypo-Bank said in an ad-hoc statement that it had said previously that it did not have any intention of running Brau und Brunnen as a subsidiary and said it did not rule out selling the company on to an individual partner.
Shares in Brau und Brunnen were suspended from trade earlier on Thursday.
Hypo-Bank owns 50 percent of Porta, with the other 50 percent held by Wood Gundy SA in Geneva.
Shares in Brau und Brunnen were suspended earlier on Thursday.
